deviations: Knesset sites (knesset.gov.il OData, fs.knesset.gov.il) returned a geo-block redirect ('maintenance-page-geo'). Gazette and bill PDFs were read through Internet Archive captures; vote, agenda and member data through the Open Knesset mirrors.

Coalition composition: Knesset records unreachable, so taken from English Wikipedia articles on the 33rd, 34th, 35th and 37th governments (infobox party lists). Corroborated by kns_persontoposition (government posts by faction on each vote date).

Knesset tables not named in the sheet were also read from the Open Knesset mirror. kns_plmsessionitem, kns_plenumsession and kns_status gave agenda dates; kns_documentbill gave bill files; kns_person matched PersonID 30716 to Rafi Peretz. votes/view_vote_rslts_hdr_approved confirmed there is no recorded vote for seq 118. All are Knesset records.

Seqs 111 and 114: Wikisource's consolidated text marks the 2020 temporary provision as expired, so the gazette PDFs were read through Internet Archive captures not listed in the sheet: 23_lsr_572953 (capture 20200605043136) and 23_lsr_578523 (capture 20210916115551). The Wikisource page links both.
Seq 92 first reading: vote 44124 (item 488358) and vote 44123 (item 487954) carry the identical roll-call tally 66-45; vote 44124 was used.
Seq 95: the sheet's 'web/2/' capture link redirected to capture 20250124104742, which was used.

Seq 106: the explanatory notes quote and discuss High Court judgments that predate the enactment (Beilin; Weiss). Those passages were disregarded; only the non-judicial explanation (Amidror committee, cabinet decision B/212) was used.
One web search for seq 99's explanatory notes listed results about litigation (Adalah, ACRI) and a Knesset Committee protocol. None was opened; a committee protocol is not a permitted source.
Web-search budget exhausted after that search, so no press reports could be searched for seq 118's tally or for any other cell.

Explanatory notes unreachable (no archive captures; Knesset server geo-blocked) for seqs 95, 99, 114, 118, 122 and 127. Reached for seqs 92 (19_ls1_245574), 103 (20_ls1_389826), 106 (20_ls1_397009) and 111 (23_ls1_571506).

Seq 118: final vote not found. No vote or per-member result for item 2151572 on 28.12.2020 in kns_plenumvote, kns_plenumvoteresult or the vote-header view (IDs 33918-33921 absent). The plenum protocol 23_ptm_593837.doc has no archive capture. coalition_only left blank.
Seqs 111 and 118: no first-reading vote is recorded in the vote tables. First-reading dates come from the plenum agenda (status 'לדיון במליאה לקראת הקריאה הראשונה': 27.5.2020 and 22.12.2020).

Seq 99: s.21A's text came from a Wikisource revision of Basic Law: The Knesset dated 2016-07-14 (MediaWiki API), since the amending law only says 'סעיף 21א - בטל'. Seq 103: ss.5-7 were read from Wikisource revisions of 2017-05-15 and 2024-10-30. Seq 122: the earlier s.42C was read from the 2022-02-15 revision.

Faction attribution for every vote was computed by joining kns_plenumvoteresult with faction membership in kns_persontoposition on the vote date. Final-vote faction counts match the sheet's extracts in every case.
The PDF text layer garbles some digits (e.g. the new figures in seq 114); only legible text is quoted. Hebrew gershayim inside JSON strings are written as '״'.
No scratch subfolder was created: the caller's instruction not to write any file overrides the sheet's working-folder rule, so all data was streamed and processed in memory.
No page about a court case was opened. Recollection of how any enactment fared was not used.
